reason: Verified. exp89t 56669888 was submitted 09:00:17Z. The thresholds are 10.2 h = 22:12:17 MSK, 10.75 h = 22:45:17 MSK and 11.0 h = 23:00:17 MSK, which is the tick deadline. card_fill_1203_v2.txt l.48 goes from 'до 22:45 МСК' straight to 'после 23:00 МСК — не финал', so it says nothing about 22:45-23:00 MSK. Under GAP RULE v2 (CONTEXT freeze (1)) and R36-A2 (i), L_hi > 10.75 h is '?', so exp89t is out of the V_pub pool in that window even at 0.960. A user reading the card could take that window as allowed. The fix is wording only: it touches no submission or kernel, and 12:03Z is about 1.5 h away. Part (i) is also accurate: L_hi is keyed on the poller header plus 210 s per failed attempt, not on completion. But it is almost cosmetic. A '+' read or a 0.959 read with UP between 22:12 and 22:45 MSK is still admitted (only flagged UNPROVEN-ins), and a '0' or '-' read never makes exp89t V_pub. Value is low. None of the 5 CI reads so far has gone above L 9.48 h; the 10.9 h tail is modelled, never observed. exp89t is expected at about 0.959, since DIS is about 0 from probe 52. So the joint chance that L lands in 10.75-11.0 h and the display is >= 0.960 is under about 2%. The session's one-line message after the read and its 22:43 MSK check would probably catch the case anyway.

Re-run the token checks and keep 'П1' at 0 occurrences.
realistic_gain: No LB or private-score gain. It is a clarity fix for a case with under ~2% chance (L in 10.75-11.0 h and display >= 0.960). It stops the user ticking a '?' file that the pre-registered GAP RULE v2 excludes. Cost is about 1 minute, with no risk.
